acc.ad.avoid_cbs_note: — Michelin ON. The "invisible cloaked" override still works separately (in the General tab).
acc.ad.avoid_mines_note: — Michelin ON. Disabling = the A* may cross minefields.
acc.ad.avoid_rad_note: — Michelin ON, disabling not advised. Without it the assistant doesn't auto-recover when entering radiation and dies.
acc.ad.collect_sight_range_note: How far the ship keeps boxes/minerals in its model. Beyond that it drops them. 0 = default. Raise it to track farther collectables.
acc.ad.collect_sight_unlimited_note: Disable the distance prune for boxes/ore: keep every collectable the server streams. Overrides the collectable sight range above.
acc.ad.combat_speed_help: How many times per second the ship recomputes and sends where it moves during combat orbit. Higher = more reactive but more server traffic. The recommended value already looks smooth without saturating the server; 'Maximum' is more reactive. Changing this only affects this aspect; the rest of the anti-detection profile still applies.
acc.ad.drone_repair_tip: Repairs each drone in the active formation when its DAMAGE reaches this %. E.g. 95 = repairs at 5% HP left. 0 = disabled. NOTE: repairing drones consumes in-game resources.
acc.ad.ignore_mine_attacks_note: — Off (default): a mine hit counts as an attack and the ship flees. On: ignores the hit and keeps operating (collect/NPC); the critical-HP safety still applies.
acc.ad.intro: Principle: by default the ship aims for maximum precision (exact centres, minimal reaction times). The 'anti-detection profile' chooses how much noise to add on top to look more human. Off (Michelin) is the most precise, recommended to see the ideal behaviour. Low/Medium/High increase jitter, delays and scheduled breaks — the higher, the more disguise but the less responsive.
acc.ad.jitter_help: Profile override. 0 = use the profile's. Adds a small variation to each move destination so the ship doesn't always hit the same pixel.
acc.ad.legacy: Legacy overrides (advanced — override the profile if set > 0)
acc.ad.legacy_help: These three fields are the older manual-tuning API. Leave them at 0 (recommended) and the profile above rules; set a value to override the matching part of the profile.
acc.ad.legacy_refresh: Every N sec of activity, pause
acc.ad.legacy_skip: Micro-pause: prob. of skipping a tick (%)
acc.ad.min_dist: Minimum distance to send an update (advanced)
acc.ad.min_dist_help: If the new destination is closer than this to the previous one, no update is sent (it's an irrelevant micro-adjust). 0 = use the profile.
acc.ad.mine_avoid_radius_note: How far the ship stays from mines when routing. 0 = automatic (conservative). A smaller value plots tighter routes that still don't set them off.
acc.ad.mine_ttl_note: Mine TTL. 0 = NO cap: a mine only goes away by server-removal or distance (never auto-drop a live hazard). Raise it only if you want them to time out.
acc.ad.module_repair_tip: Repairs damaged equipment modules in the inventory (lasers/generators/shields) when their DAMAGE reaches this %, while AT a base. E.g. 50 = repairs at 50% HP remaining. 0 = disabled (default). NOTE: spends in-game currency (per-module repair cost).
acc.ad.npc_sight_range_note: How far the ship keeps NPCs in its model. The server streams you farther NPCs; beyond this we drop them, so the ship neither sees nor chases them. 0 = default. Raise it to see/chase farther NPCs (e.g. a stationary boss). Note: setting it below the attack range blocks acquiring what was already dropped.
acc.ad.npc_sight_unlimited_note: Disable the distance prune for NPCs: keep every NPC the server streams, no matter how far. Overrides the sight range above. Closest to the real client (which never prunes by distance). Costs a bit more memory/CPU but the server already bounds what it sends.
acc.ad.pathfinding_help: Michelin defaults = all enabled. Disable only if you know what you're doing.
acc.ad.profile_note: The profile is the master: it sets movement jitter, combat timing, scheduled breaks and responsiveness all at once. The fields below fine-tune it.
acc.ad.prune_ttl_note: How many seconds we keep an object in the model without seeing it again, as a cap in case we miss the server's removal. 0 = default.
acc.ad.route_vary_deaths_note: After N deaths on the map (this session), routing avoids the spots where you were killed, so later routes go around the ambush zones and differ from the one that cost you the ship.
acc.ad.skip_note: Independent extra, not part of the profile. 0 = never skips.
acc.ad.tick_tip: Interval between engine cycles (ms). The anti-detection profile sets a minimum for its level; if you set a lower value, the profile wins. Lower = more reactive, more traffic.
acc.ad.title: Anti-detection
acc.ad.ttl_unlimited_note: Disables age-based pruning for this type: the object is only dropped by distance or when the server removes it (just like mines). Ignores the TTL seconds above.
acc.auction.ab_intro: The assistant bids by itself on items with a rule, within the caps. It SPENDS real credits when it wins. Tip: turn on simulation mode to see what it would bid without spending, then turn it off once you trust the config.
acc.auction.ab_norules: No rules. Hit “+ auto” on an auction item, or add one.
acc.auction.intro: Bid on premium items with credits/uridium. Bidding and buying spend account currency — we always ask for confirmation. The assistant must be connected.
acc.auction.load_connect_tip: when the account connects (Start or Pause), the assistant fetches the auction list by itself and refreshes it every 5 min — and if auto-bid is enabled, it starts on its own: fully automatic. Saves instantly.
acc.auction.noinfo: No data — hit Load/refresh (the assistant must be connected).
acc.auction.title: Auction House
acc.booster.intro: Automatically buy boosters based on what the assistant is doing at each moment. Never buys during Palladium.
acc.booster.min_uridium: Don't buy if uridium is below
acc.booster.mode_note: A subscription automatically re-buys the booster with uridium when it expires, until you cancel it. It spends uridium recurrently. Experimental feature, not yet verified: use at your own discretion.
acc.booster.palladium_note: Boosters are never bought during Palladium, by design.
acc.booster.title: Boosters by context
acc.cbs.intro: It arrives through the Live stream (the assistant must be connected). The current map's CBS and the galactic list show up when you enter maps; "Refresh" requests your clan's CBS + the history (only if you're in a clan). An "open" CBS (no deflector shield) attacks anyone not in the owner clan or allied within its turret range — the assistant flees if it enters that range.
acc.cfg.admin_caution_suffix: react if a game-master appears in your area (anti-ban)
acc.cfg.admin_caution_tip: A human moderator watching can be a risk. Reacts when a GM / referee is detected in the area.
acc.cfg.cbs_as_safe_tip: When the assistant needs to go to a safe zone, it considers your clan / faction / NAP CBS as a valid destination if closer. Only built, non-hostile CBS. Also lets it heal in place if you're already near a friendly CBS.
acc.cfg.cbs_global_unsafe_tip: Off (default): Global clans (no company) are safe — their CBS won't shoot or be avoided unless you attack or someone from the clan attacks you. On: treat them as hostile (avoid in pathing, don't use as a refuge).
acc.cfg.claim_battle_tip: Collects Battle Pass quest rewards when pending. Re-arms as you complete quests during the session.
acc.cfg.claim_calendar_tip: The mini-client bonus calendar (MiniClientReward). Claims the daily prize when the server marks it available. Once per session.
acc.cfg.claim_daily_tip: Once per session, if a gift is pending. The server resets at midnight.
acc.cfg.claim_monthly_tip: Once per session, if the server marks the Monthly Deluxe calendar day as claimable. If the account has no Deluxe, it does nothing.
acc.cfg.claim_returnee_tip: Once per session, claims the Returnee calendar: daily prize + initial prize, if the server marks them claimable. If the account is not 'returnee', it does nothing.
acc.cfg.claim_season_tip: Claims ALL pending Season Pass rewards (claim-all) when the server reports unclaimed ones. Free always; gold only if you own the pass. Once per session.
acc.cfg.dodge_in_map_suffix: — move to the other side, keeps operating
acc.cfg.dodge_in_map_tip: If an enemy player enters sight (≤ sight range) AND is not attacking you: the assistant moves in the opposite direction within the same map. It does not leave the area, and resumes activity once they are no longer visible.
acc.cfg.enemy_alert_jump_map_tip: Map ID to jump to with the 'jump' action. 0 or the current map → falls back to 'flee'.
acc.cfg.enemy_alert_tip: When there are at least N enemies on the map, it triggers the chosen action (flee or cloak) — unlike flee/dodge which react by proximity. The radar (server) count needs the Radar CPU equipped; 'sight' counts the enemy players you can see.
acc.cfg.flee_ability_min_tip: Only activates the ability if the threat is at least N u away (otherwise it may be too late). 0 = always activate. Default: 1500.
acc.cfg.flee_ability_tip: Activates this slot-bar ability while fleeing. Useful for speed boosters, cloak, shield emergency. Empty = none.
acc.cfg.flee_if_no_finish: Flee sooner if not finishing an NPC
acc.cfg.flee_if_no_finish_tip: Intermediate threshold (when you are NOT finishing an NPC): if HP drops below this %, it flees anyway — more cautious out of combat. Always kept WITHIN the band: between 'Flee below' (floor) and 'Heal until' (ceiling). Default 50%.
acc.cfg.flee_intro: How to react to enemies in sight, which shelter to pick, what ability to use when escaping.
acc.cfg.flee_to_safe_tip: Paranoia mode. If an enemy player enters sight → full flee to base/portal. If you enable this + Dodge at once, this one wins (more conservative).
acc.cfg.foot_note: Empty fields use the assistant's default (the placeholders). Saving applies hot if the assistant is running (no reconnect) and affects all sections, not just the one you're viewing.
acc.cfg.formations_owned_only_tip: Filters the formation autocomplete to the ones your account owns (source: inventory, loaded at login). If no formation data is in the inventory, shows all (hides nothing).
acc.cfg.gen_intro: Configure what the assistant does, where it operates, and how it protects itself. Activation (start/pause/stop) goes through the Live console buttons. The internal order of the engine steps is edited in Pipeline (advanced).
acc.cfg.hp_flee_below_tip: Flee threshold: if HP drops below this %, the assistant goes to heal. Leave blank or 0 to turn it off (no flee from this threshold; the 'Flee early if you can't finish an NPC' net still applies). Default 35%.
acc.cfg.hp_heal_until_tip: Return threshold: once healing, it keeps going until HP climbs above this % before re-engaging. Blank or 0 = default 85%. For heal-to-100% set 100.
acc.cfg.life_intro: When to break off combat and get back to the action.
acc.cfg.natural_disconnect_tip: Closes the session gracefully and waits a few seconds for the server to end it, like a real player (instead of cutting the connection outright).
acc.cfg.note_palladium_level: The Palladium module operates in 5-3 (pirate sector 5-x). The 5-x maps require level 12+: a lower-level account can't enter, and the assistant will stop and warn.
acc.cfg.pause_after_tip: POST-REVIVE window: the assistant does nothing for the first N seconds after spawn. Gives the server time to stabilize the re-init. Default: 90 s.
acc.cfg.pause_before_tip: Delay before clicking revive. Useful to look human and soften the lock-on when respawning in PvP. Default: 5 s.
acc.cfg.portal_far_tip: When fleeing, if a portal is right next to the enemy (closer than this threshold), the assistant looks for a farther one. Default: 1500 u.
acc.cfg.priority_tip: Only in Kill & Collect: what the assistant prioritises when there are NPCs AND boxes at once. NPCs = fight first (default). Boxes = collect first if one is near (within the collect radius). Closest = whatever is nearest (box or NPC). Never abandons a kill in progress.
acc.cfg.remember_attacker_tip: After being attacked by a player, the assistant treats them as a threat for N seconds even if they stop firing. Default: 300 s.
acc.cfg.repair_heal_peace: Heal in place in a safe zone
acc.cfg.repair_heal_peace_tip: If the ship needs to repair and is ALREADY in a peace area / base / station, it heals right there instead of flying to a portal. Avoids interrupting collection by traveling when you're already safe. If HP is critically low and still taking damage, it still escapes. The friendly-CBS part is enabled by the option below.
acc.cfg.repair_to_shield_tip: At shelter, keeps repairing until the shield reaches this %. 0 = ignore shield (HP only).
acc.cfg.revive_at_tip: Where the assistant respawns after dying. Base = teleport home. Portal = the nearest jumpgate. Same place = where you fell (risky).
acc.cfg.revive_intro: What the assistant does after dying.
acc.cfg.ship_active_tip: Change the assistant's active ship. Shows the current ship plus a dropdown of the rest. Hitting Change DISCONNECTS the assistant, activates the other ship and RECONNECTS (relocating you to its map, ~40s) — the same mechanism as the palladium loop. Load the hangar at a base to populate the ships.
acc.cfg.ship_config_help: The game has 2 configs (1/2). The assistant rotates them by state. Cooldown ≥ 8 s between changes.
acc.cfg.ship_swap_tip: Change to the selected ship (disconnects and reconnects, ~40s)
acc.cfg.sight_range_tip: Distance from which an enemy player counts as visible. Default: 4000 u.
acc.cfg.state_attacking_tip: The default ammo is configured in NPC killer. Each NPC table rule can override it per-NPC with AttackKey.
acc.cfg.stop_after_deaths_tip: 0 = no limit. When reached, the assistant goes to STOPPED and won't restart until you reset it.
acc.cfg.stop_when_safe_tip: When you click Stop, the assistant first navigates to a base or portal (the map's safe zone) and only disconnects once it arrives. If it can't make it in 60s (hunted/trapped), it disconnects anyway. Combine with 'Disconnect naturally' below — first reach safe, then send Logout.
acc.cfg.travel_jcpu_min_note: Only spends the CPU if normal flight would cost at least this many portal jumps. Empty = 4.
acc.cfg.travel_jcpu_note: With the Advanced Jump CPU equipped, jumps DIRECTLY to the target map (costs uridium per jump, server price). If the CPU is unavailable or the server disallows the target, normal portal travel continues.
acc.cfg.travel_jcpu_uri_note: TOTAL uridium the CPU may spend on jumps this session (jump vouchers are used first, free). When used up it stops using the CPU. 0 = no cap.
acc.cfg.travel_swap_min_note: Only switches ship if it saves at least this many portal jumps (the change costs ~2-3 jumps worth of time). Empty = 3.
acc.cfg.travel_swap_note: When traveling to a distant map, if another hangar ship is parked closer to the target, switch to that ship (~15-30s reconnect) and continue from there instead of flying the whole portal chain. Does not apply to the palladium cycle.
acc.cfg.working_map_tip: Grayed-out maps = your level can't reach them (the assistant warns and stays where it is).
acc.clan.already_in: You're already in a clan. Leave it (in “My clan”) before founding one.
acc.clan.confirm_delete: Delete the clan? This cannot be undone.
acc.clan.confirm_transfer: Transfer leadership to this member? You will no longer be the leader.
acc.clan.connect: Connect the assistant to see the clan list.
acc.clan.leave_confirm: Are you sure you want to leave the clan?
acc.clan.name: Name
acc.clan.none: No clan (or the assistant is not connected — the clan loads when you sign in to the third-party game).
acc.clan.subject: Subject
acc.clt.adj_radius_tip: While orbiting an NPC, if a box is within ≤ this radius the assistant grabs it without leaving the orbit. Default: 400 u.
acc.clt.autocloak: Auto-cloak while collecting — activates the CPU while in COLLECT
acc.clt.autocloak_tip: Keeps the cloak active while the assistant is in the COLLECT state. Auto-detects the equipped cloak CPU (CL04K / CL04K XL) — nothing to configure. Useful to hide the ship during long runs.
acc.clt.buycloak: Buy Cloaking Device (cl04k-xs) — 500 uridium, single-use, when no CPU
acc.clt.buycloak_tip: Sub-option of Auto-cloak: when NO cloak CPU is equipped, buys the single-use consumable (cl04k-xs, 500 uridium) to cloak. Requires Auto-cloak enabled. NOTE: spends 500 uridium per purchase; with anti-cloak mines that decloak you, it may re-buy when re-hiding.
acc.clt.catalog_help: Mark which items you collect and which you ignore. Prio (lower = first) decides between eligible items. Wait (ms) is an anti-retry cooldown on the same item. Limit/session (only where it applies) stops collecting once N items are reached.
acc.clt.cbs_invisible_tip: Treat hostile CBS as harmless while cloaked. Useful for collect routes near enemy CBS that don't detect you while invisible.
acc.clt.col_limit_tip: How many to collect per session (0/empty = no limit). Only applies to items where it makes sense (pirate booty, events).
acc.clt.combine_help: Collect adjacent boxes while orbiting an NPC, without losing the lock.
acc.clt.cross_frame_tip: Lets the bot cross the yellow guide frame (the limit before the radiation) to grab items that drop in the band between the frame and the red zone. The radiation stays a hard limit. Off: those items are skipped (avoids getting stuck). Works in gates and normal maps.
acc.clt.footer: Missing a type? You can type it into any empty row by searching for it here — or paste it as new into the profile JSON (the assistant accepts any BoxType the server emits).
acc.clt.grab_dist_tip: At this distance the ship considers itself over the box and collects it.
acc.clt.ignore_contested: Ignore contested collectables — skip boxes and ores another player will reach first (by ETA)
acc.clt.ignore_contested_tip: Anti-waste: don't chase lost races. Compares the real arrival time (ETA) — who gets there first — using each ship's speed and heading. Applies to ALL collectables (boxes + ores). Michelin: ON. Turn it off for an aggressive 'compete for everything' mode.
acc.clt.intro: How the assistant looks for boxes and minerals, what it avoids, and how it combines collecting with combat. Per box type rules (priority, ignore, cooldowns) live in the Box table tab.
acc.clt.keys_empty: No info — connect the assistant so the inventory arrives.
acc.clt.keys_help: How many of each key/special item you own (booty keys, echo keys, fragments, etc.). Read from your live inventory; shows the ones you have (count > 0).
acc.clt.note_cloak_collect_only: Useful only in Collect module — firing breaks the cloak, and Kill has no collect phase.
acc.clt.note_combat_needs_combat: Only applies with combat (module Kill or Kill & Collect) — there's no fighting in Collect.
acc.clt.range_help: How far it looks for boxes, when it grabs them, and where it roams between rounds.
acc.clt.reset_all_tip: Reset the catalog (clears ✓ Collect, priority and limit on every row)
acc.clt.reset_body:
Clears ✓ Collect, priority and limit on EVERY row, and removes custom rows.

The assistant stops collecting until you check items again.
acc.clt.roam_radius_tip: When there's nothing to collect or attack, the assistant roams within this radius around its position. 0 = the whole map (Michelin).
acc.clt.search_radius_tip: Max distance at which the assistant considers a box a target. Michelin default: 4000 u.
acc.clt.selected_tip: items with ✓ Collect ticked · click to show only those
acc.clt.stay_away: Keep distance from hostiles — skip boxes within <1500 u of an enemy player
acc.clt.stay_away_tip: Useful for PvP zones. The assistant ignores boxes stuck next to an enemy even if they meet the rest of the filters.
acc.clt.steer: Go fetch boxes during combat — break the orbit to approach a box while you keep firing
acc.clt.steer_tip: Without this, the assistant only grabs boxes the orbit passes over (Adjacent box radius). With this, during combat the assistant moves toward a nearby collectible box (within the Collection radius) and grabs it while still firing at the NPC — more efficient. It won't if the NPC is nearly dead (<25% HP): it finishes the kill first. Opt-in.
acc.clt.title: Collect
acc.dosid.fastsid_tip: Copy the Fast SID (server + dosid in one token) for quick injection with the play-launcher
acc.dosid.fresh_tip: created <24h ago — probably still valid (servers restart ~00:00 / on patches)
acc.dosid.none: no cached dosid yet — it is saved only when the account connects
acc.dosid.obtained_tip: when this dosid was obtained (full login)
acc.dosid.stale_tip: created ≥24h ago — possibly expired (daily restart / patch)
acc.dosid.used_tip: last connection that used this dosid
acc.gg.abg_stop_note: Tick per gate when to stop spinning: once it's on the map and/or has a reserve built. Since one ABG spin builds α/β/γ at once, the spinner STOPS entirely as soon as the FIRST gate meets what you ticked.
acc.gg.adaptive_spin: Adaptive spin (100 far from done, down to 1 near it)
acc.gg.ammo_btn_tip: This gate's ammo: laser / rocket / launcher + capacity. Overrides the global while running THIS gate (blank = inherit the global).
acc.gg.auto_dse: Auto-run Deep Space Echoes (build ship squad)
acc.gg.bonuscat_empty: no bonus observed yet — they appear here when the game attaches one to a gate
acc.gg.bonuscat_intro: Which bonuses have shown up on each gate. The game exposes no fixed list — it's built from what the assistant observes.
acc.gg.border_note: Keeps the ship a minimum distance from the frame: it never drives straight to the edge (it orbits the target from the inner side and backs off toward the centre, not into the corner), so it doesn't get pinned at the border and then have to cross back through the pack. The corner-incursion can still cross when needed. Only inside the gate.
acc.gg.border_toggle: Avoid the border (don't glue to the frame)
acc.gg.bubble_note: Keeps the other targets (not the one you're attacking) outside a minimum safety distance. If the nearest one closes in, the ship repositions to restore the margin before continuing, without stopping fire. Only inside the gate.
acc.gg.buylives_max: Buy up to N lives per run (0 = off)
acc.gg.calib_confirmed: corner-calibrated reach (confirmed — the ship uses it)
acc.gg.calib_measuring_tip: reach measured in this gate — confirm in another GG for the ship to use it
acc.gg.calib_model_tip: not measured yet — the ship uses the estimate. Turn on 'Corner range calibration' to measure the real one.
acc.gg.calib_reach_tip: The ENEMY's reach measured in the corner (different from “Fire dist.”, which is YOUR position). The ship uses it once confirmed.
acc.gg.calib_sat_tip: the NPC already hit at the top of the tested range: its real reach is ≥ this value and can't be pinned down in the corner — the ship uses the estimate
acc.gg.calib_suggested: measuring reach in the corner (suggested; confirm in another GG to use it)
acc.gg.calib_sweeping_tip: the ship moves in until the NPC fires; no hit yet (reach shorter than this distance, or a passive/dead NPC)
acc.gg.cfg_btn_tip: Gate combat config: general preset + per phase (attacking / flying / tank) + formation.
acc.gg.cfg_phases_note: Ship config + formation PER combat PHASE: Attacking (fighting the wave) · Flying (moving with no wave) · Tank (surrounded by many) · Healing (repairing). «—» = inherit the active config.
acc.gg.co_range_tip: YOUR fire distance when hunting corner runners (0 = auto). Not the enemy's reach.
acc.gg.debuglog_note: Writes the full combat decision state to the server log every ~1.5s inside a gate: phase/wave, NPC counts by category (following us / in a corner / softened / reachable / blacklisted) and a per-NPC breakdown + the current target. For diagnosis only; produces a verbose log.
acc.gg.debuglog_toggle: Debug Run Gates (enter+combat) in the log
acc.gg.devmode_note: Turns on all GG debug logging and reveals the advanced tuning dials (below). Leave it off for normal use.
acc.gg.disable_kami: Disable kami with ≤ N NPCs (inside the gate)
acc.gg.disp_auto_note: Background: collects ready missions and sends available gates while slots are free. Never buys slots, and pauses inside a Galaxy Gate.
acc.gg.disp_buy_slot_confirm: Buy a dispatch slot? Costs uridium.
acc.gg.disp_feed_note: The spinner builds the chosen types (without placing them) and auto-dispatch sends them; they rebuild as they're dispatched. Reuses the GG energy/uridium budget.
acc.gg.disp_hire_note: Fills free slots with the cheapest retriever within the cap. Never buys slots.
acc.gg.disp_only_note: The bot never places or runs any gate: it only builds and dispatches (passive harvest).
acc.gg.disp_quick_max: Max coupons per session (0 = no limit):
acc.gg.disp_quick_note: Spends Quick Coupons to instantly finish in-progress retrievers and free slots faster.
acc.gg.drag_note: AUTO-SMART: the ship kites (circling while firing at the NPC train) ONLY when several are chasing and could corner it. With few or none it orbits and fights normally instead of running off. While kiting it paces itself so pursuers don't fall behind, and always stays inside the frame (never into the radiation).
acc.gg.drag_toggle: Loop dragging the NPCs (don't orbit in place)
acc.gg.drag_tune_note: Live dials for drag mode (no recompile). Leave 0 = auto/default. The ship loops an interior circle dragging the train and fires the nearest; the pace self-adjusts to keep the target within your reach.
acc.gg.dragclassic_note: A classic combat preset in a single switch: uses the single-path, range-aware kiting and turns off the newer add-ons — the spin-around-target, the surround evade and the edge cushion. Handy to compare the classic style against the new one. Default OFF.
acc.gg.dragkami_any: Any as soon as it's in range
acc.gg.dragkami_tip: While you kite the NPC train, sets off the pet kamikaze on the chaser once it's in range. No HP threshold — it's area damage across the train.
acc.gg.dragkami_toggle: Use the pet kamikaze while dragging
acc.gg.dragorbit_note: In kiting mode, instead of circling the map centre the ship spins around the target at firing range (the laser stays on it, and by spinning the group can't focus-fire you), and that whole spin drifts along the kiting path that drags the train. All with the laser. Only while kiting, inside the gate.
acc.gg.empty: — no Galaxy Gate Builder data (press Refresh)
acc.gg.end_intro: Actions when a run finishes. Config can be overridden by the Phoenix switcher if it's on (formation and PET aren't).
acc.gg.end_pet: Activate PET at the end of the gate
acc.gg.end_title: At the end of the gate
acc.gg.engine_always_note: Core engine behaviours that ALWAYS run in the background during auto-gate — they don't turn off. This is where the foundational pieces get consolidated.
acc.gg.engine_it_border: Avoid the border — keeps the ship off the frame: it orbits the target from the inner side and backs off toward the centre, not into the corner, so it doesn't get pinned at the edge. The corner-incursion can still cross when needed. Can be turned OFF per gate/wave in the Logic popover.
acc.gg.engine_it_cornerleave: Leave corner-runners — leaves the NPCs fleeing to the corner and fights the followers (advances the wave without chasing to the corner or diving into the radiation). Can be turned OFF per gate/wave in the Logic popover.
acc.gg.engine_it_entry: Portal-centre entry — crosses only through the target gate's centre (never the neighbour).
acc.gg.engine_it_evade: Surround evasion — when NPCs cover the ship from several directions at once (cross-fire), it stops orbiting and moves to the safest gap to avoid damage (the target takes a back seat). Can be turned OFF per gate/wave in the Logic popover.
acc.gg.engine_it_incursion: Corner incursion (unsticks stalled waves) — if every NPC parks too deep and the wave stalls, it dips the minimum into the radiation to finish them, with the HP-flee as a safety net.
acc.gg.engine_it_learn: Tunes the combat distance from each NPC's observed range and damage.
acc.gg.engine_it_nolimit: No acquisition limit inside a gate — the assistant targets ANY NPC in the instance regardless of distance (key to finishing waves with far-corner stragglers). On a normal map the "Search range" still applies.
acc.gg.engine_it_safebox: Movement stays inside the safe zone at all times — never enters the radiation (except as a last resort).
acc.gg.engine_it_safepos: Safe positioning — avoids the radiation and NPC clusters when picking a target; won't chase into the radiation or cross the swarm (picks the nearest reachable NPC and routes around the group).
acc.gg.engine_it_throttle: Jump anti-spam — jumps are rate-limited so the server is never flooded.
acc.gg.engine_it_wave: Tracks the waves and advances the gate's checkpoints automatically.
acc.gg.evade_note: When targets cover the ship from several directions at once (cross-fire), the ship stops orbiting/circling in place and moves to the safest gap to avoid damage — the target takes a back seat. Works with any NPC. Only inside the gate.
acc.gg.fieldloop_note: Sub-option of field mode: the ship runs a fixed ring centred on the map instead of orbiting the target. Removes the corner problem by geometry. Experimental.
acc.gg.gate_end_tip: Actions when THIS gate finishes (reward window, last wave cleared): reward config & formation, launch the PET in Guard mode and hold the P.E.T kamikaze at ≤ N NPCs. — = inherit the saved global default.
acc.gg.gate_maxruns_tip: How many times to run THIS gate before moving to the next in the list. 0 = no per-gate cap (the global total cap still applies).
acc.gg.gate_ship_tip: The combat ship/hangar to run THIS gate with (swapped automatically when the portal is detected, before entering). The spinner Phoenix stays global. Empty = use the global ship.
acc.gg.gop.btn_tip: Gauntlet of Plutus settings (difficulty and boss-room behaviour)
acc.gg.gop.clearambients_tip: Before attacking the turrets, clear the whole ambient NPC population of the room first. Turn it off to go straight to the turrets and ignore the ambientals.
acc.gg.gop.difficulty_tip: Which version to run: Normal (full rewards) or Easy. A single daily entry counts for either one.
acc.gg.gop.emp_note: That effect isn't detected live yet (pending); for now the switch stays inactive.
acc.gg.gop.emp_tip: Fire an EMP to clear the boss's slow in the final room.
acc.gg.gop.retaliate_tip: If an ambient NPC attacks you first, you fire back. Also, if you're repairing at low HP and clear of every turret, the ship plants at fire range and kills the chasers (instead of kiting away) — that frees the hull repair. If a turret is near, it keeps kiting so it doesn't wake it.
acc.gg.gop.standstill_tip: On entering the boss room, hold still for about 10s before moving so the scene finishes loading — the first move then won't wake the turrets.
acc.gg.history_intro: Energy spent and the item types each recent spin produced.
acc.gg.incorner_tip: Loadout (config/formation/ammo/PET/fire distance) used ONLY in the phase of finishing the NPCs that fled to the corner. The fire distance overrides, per gate/wave, the global SAFE POSITIONING default.
acc.gg.internal_note: Engine-internal behaviours during the gate run (detection, movement). Advanced — leave at the defaults unless you know what they do.
acc.gg.kami_intro: With many NPCs in sight, use a tank ship preset (priority over fighting/repairing). Pair with the PET Kamikaze gear and buy-lives. Both fields > 0 to enable.
acc.gg.kamicorner_tip: When the ship gets stuck on NPCs that fled to a corner (which would otherwise make it dive into the radiation), it sends the pet kamikaze out instead: the ship stays inside the frame and the pet flies out to detonate on the straggler. Clears the stragglers without exposing the ship. Consumes the pet (it re-launches). Requires the pet enabled.
acc.gg.kamicorner_toggle: Pet kamikaze to the corner (don't dive)
acc.gg.live_note: Progress updates live. Click a gate to select it.
acc.gg.lives_btn_tip: Lives: open the gate panel for life purchase (buy X when ≤ Y), the lives abort, and future options.
acc.gg.makeuntil_tip: Pick how far into the gate to run. It finishes that section and leaves at the next portal (checkpoint). 'Complete the whole gate' = clear it all. The final section isn't offered — there's no portal after it.
acc.gg.modparams_note: Fine-tune the internal modules. Empty = default value (the placeholder). Can be overridden per gate/wave from the wave plan.
acc.gg.mpd.border.margin: How far from the arena edge the ship starts steering back inward: keeps it off the frame and out of corners. Higher = stays farther from the edge.
acc.gg.mpd.border.penalty: How strongly the ship avoids the edge. Higher = keeps away from the frame more insistently.
acc.gg.mpd.bubble.floor: Smallest distance the safety bubble ever uses: NPCs farther than this never trigger a brake. Higher = keeps more space.
acc.gg.mpd.bubble.headroom: How far below your own firing distance the bubble stops acting: keeps it from braking for an NPC already at your combat range. Higher = less braking.
acc.gg.mpd.bubble.reachFrac: How early the ship brakes when another NPC drifts close while you fight your target. Higher = brakes from farther.
acc.gg.mpd.corner.calibrate: Lets the ship measure an NPC's real reach against a stationary corner target, so combat distances rest on measurement rather than an estimate. 0 = off.
acc.gg.mpd.dash.evadeSpeed: How fast an NPC must be closing before the ship treats it as a charge and backs off ahead of the hit. Auto-tunes on the waves where it matters; higher = only reacts to the fastest chargers. Blank = default.
acc.gg.mpd.drag.cruiseHop: How fast the ship advances along the kiting path while the target is within your range. Higher = moves quicker.
acc.gg.mpd.drag.fireDist: Fixes your firing distance inside the gate (per wave/gate/global). 0 = automatic. Takes priority over the automatic range.
acc.gg.mpd.drag.holdHop: How slowly the ship creeps while the target is out of range but closing, so it can close the gap. Lower = lets it catch up sooner.
acc.gg.mpd.drag.loopCurlDeg: How tightly the kiting circle curves: higher aims further ahead each step for a sharper turn.
acc.gg.mpd.drag.loopRadius: Size of the circle the ship kites on. 0 = automatic.
acc.gg.mpd.drag.minChasers: How many pursuers it takes before the ship switches to kiting instead of standing and fighting.
acc.gg.mpd.field.antiWindup: Smooths the aim correction so it doesn't overshoot on fast movers. 0 = off, 1 = on.
acc.gg.mpd.incursion.delaySec: How long to wait when a wave stalls with every NPC parked out of reach before making a brief push to finish them.
acc.gg.mpd.orbitLoop.centreX: Manual left/right shift of the kiting path (+ right / − left). 0 = centred. Overrides the Corner farm side when set by hand.
acc.gg.mpd.orbitLoop.drift: How much the orbit slides along each lap while kiting: larger values sweep a wider path.
acc.gg.mpd.orbitLoop.focusOffset: How far the kiting path leans toward the side you picked in Corner farm, to herd fleeing NPCs into that side's corners. 0 = automatic.
acc.gg.mpd.reach.edgeMargin: Fine margin that decides how far outside an NPC's reach the ship tries to sit. Smaller = sits you closer to the edge (a little more damage taken, a little more firing time). 0 = default.
acc.gg.mpd.repairOrbit.ring: How wide the ship circles while it repairs.
acc.gg.mpd.steer.cornerEscalateSec: After this many seconds stuck in a corner, force a switch to the other side to break free. 0 = off.
acc.gg.mpd.steer.flipMargin: How much better the other side must be to count when reversing orbit direction. 0 = automatic.
acc.gg.mpd.steer.flipTicks: How long the other side must clearly be better before the ship reverses its orbit direction: stops it flip-flopping. 0 = off.
acc.gg.mpd.swarm.retreatDpsPct: If incoming damage climbs past this share of your effective health each second, the ship pulls back out of reach and switches to rockets/launcher until it recovers. 0 = off.
acc.gg.mpd.trinity.arena: Which Trinity Trials arena to enter. Auto = the open one with a free attempt. Hellfire / Genome only if open today.
acc.gg.mpd.trinity.claimPass: Automatically claims the unlocked rewards of the Trinity season pass. The VIP row only if your account already owns the VIP badge — it is never bought.
acc.gg.mpd.trinity.difficulty: Entry difficulty. Max unlocked = the highest your Orbital Sweeper level allows. 1-5 = cap it to that value.
acc.gg.mpd.trinity.upgradeOS: Automatically upgrades the Orbital Sweeper module by spending the Quantum Prisms harvested in the trials (unlocks difficulties and better drops). Never spends uridium and never skips the upgrade timer.
acc.gg.mpd.trinity.useTokens: If no free attempt is left today, spend Trinity Tokens to enter. Default is free attempts only (tokens cost real money).
acc.gg.mpd.voyagers.claimPass: Auto-claims the unlocked rewards of the Voyagers season pass. The VIP row only if your account already owns the badge — never buys it.
acc.gg.mpd.voyagers.level: Ascent level to run. 0 = auto (highest unlocked).
acc.gg.mpd.voyagers.tokensHave: Oath Tokens the account owns to buy extra attempts. Refreshes when the assistant reads the Voyagers portal window — until then it shows "—" (unknown).
acc.gg.mpd.voyagers.useTokens: How to enter when no free attempt is left. Oath Tokens (ore 68) cost; by default only free attempts are used.
acc.gg.mpd.waveControl.leaveAtHpPct: HP level at which a fleeing NPC is considered softened and left behind so the wave keeps moving. 0 = default.
acc.gg.noenter_lives_tip: PREVENTION: won't start a run on a portal that has few lives left. Entering on the last life means a single death loses the whole portal. Different from "Abort the run if lives ≤", which reacts once you are already inside, and from buying lives, which only happens inside. It skips that portal and moves to the next by priority; if none are left the assistant keeps working (it never ends the session over this). Each portal can set its own value. 0 = off.
acc.gg.npcrange_note: Pin an NPC's attack range (in u) so the ship stays outside its reach. Handy if the automatic value isn't right yet. Matches by name/type substring (e.g. 'Protegit'). Empty = use the automatic value. Range is intrinsic to the NPC → global, not per-gate.
acc.gg.onecorner_note: Leans the kiting path to one side so the NPCs fleeing at low HP pile onto that side's corners instead of all four — much faster to finish off. This is the global layer: each gate and each wave can override it (inherit/ON/OFF) from the Logic popover. How far it leans is set by 'Corner farm: offset' (0 = automatic). Default OFF.
acc.gg.panel_intro: Spin to collect parts. Once a gate is complete, materialize it (it appears on the map, ready to enter).
acc.gg.portal_maps_tip: Maps where this gate's entry portal has appeared (the assistant learns them as it sees them)
acc.gg.posmode_note: Picks WHICH logic moves the ship while fighting inside a portal. "Built-in" is the usual engine (drag, orbit, bubble, border avoidance). "Potential field" is an alternative engine, reproduced AS-IS from an external model, unadapted: it predicts the enemy using the measured latency, corrects the hold distance tick by tick, chooses the turn direction by scoring both ways, and uses its own reach table per enemy type. Being faithful to the original, it ignores your pinned distances and does not use learned reaches, so against modern enemies it will sit too close. It exists to COMPARE: run a portal with each and look at the stats. Experimental, not validated live. Default: Built-in.
acc.gg.rad_depth_note: Gate NPCs park in the corners (radiation) and don't come out. The assistant tries to fire from the safe edge first; if they're out of reach it dips the MINIMUM into the radiation (up to this cap) to hit them, with the HP-flee as the safety net. 0 = use the default (1200u). Raise it if your corner NPCs stay alive; lower it to risk less.
acc.gg.reachprio_note: Inside a gate, attacks first the NPCs whose reach exceeds your laser's: you can't keep those out of range and they hit you for free from afar while you fight someone else. Your explicit priority in the NPC table still wins. Each gate and each wave can override it (inherit/ON/OFF) from the Logic popover. Default OFF.
acc.gg.repair_note: Movement while healing inside a gate: by default it backs off and waits; with orbit on, it circles the nearest NPC at a fixed distance (never stands still, resumes combat instantly).
acc.gg.repair_orbit_tip: Circles the nearest NPC at the ring distance while healing; flips direction when the border or a zone blocks the ring. Off = back away and wait (classic behaviour).
acc.gg.reserve_abg_note: Not applicable under ABG — use the table below.
acc.gg.reserve_policy_note: The game allows at most 1 gate on the map + 1 in reserve per type. 'One' places 1 on the map; 'Reserve' also always keeps 1 ready (2/2).
acc.gg.reserve_policy_tip: How deep each Build-ticked gate is built: 'One' builds and places 1 on the map; 'Reserve' also pre-builds 1 spare copy (1 on the map + 1 ready). Once a gate reaches its depth, the builder moves on to the next gate by priority on its own. For 'build exactly N and stop' use the 'Stop after N gates' knob. Not applicable under ABG: the per-gate table governs stops and reserves.
acc.gg.reserve_runlist_note: With several gates ticked Build (run list) they all get filled automatically, by priority.
acc.gg.rg_use_learned_tip: Copies the learned Min/Max into the Fix band — the ship stops using auto-range and uses these saved values.
acc.gg.run_intro: Enters gates that are already on the map, lets combat clear the waves, then exits and repeats. It does NOT build — turn on the Autobuilder (and auto-place) to build the gates.
acc.gg.run_list_intro: Per gate: tick Build to autobuild it (spin + place), Run to enter + clear it, and set priority (1 = first). The Autobuilder / Run masters enable each; spins & multiplier live in the GG Spinner sub-tab.
acc.gg.run_logout: Log out when no gates left
acc.gg.safetgt_note: Inside the gate, NPCs flee to the corners (near the radiation) and pile up. With this on the assistant won't chase a target into the radiation or cross the NPC cluster to reach it: it switches to the nearest reachable NPC and routes around the group on approach.
acc.gg.safetgt_toggle: Avoid radiation and NPC clusters when picking a target
acc.gg.spin_rate_note: The Galaxy Gate generator is capped by the server at about 3 spins/s; faster gets rejected. To build quicker, raise the spin amount (batch) instead of the rate.
acc.gg.spinner_debuglog_note: Writes the autobuilder's [GG-DEV] trace: active mode, the 3 gate refs (dropdown / build / spin + which one drove), the gate state (parts, placed, serverSel, errors) and the decision (SPIN / IDLE / BACKOFF / WARMUP / STOP). For diagnosing the build; separate from Run Gates.
acc.gg.spinner_debuglog_toggle: Debug the Spinner (autobuilder) in the log
acc.gg.spinonbonus: Spin only with an active bonus
acc.gg.spinonbonus_gear: Choose which bonuses trigger the spinner
acc.gg.spinonbonus_note: Spins only when one of the selected gates (below) currently has one of the selected bonuses (gear) active — if they coincide at that moment, it spins. Nothing selected = any gate / any bonus. It's the precise version of “Bonus rewards day” (the global event).
acc.gg.spinonev_note: Tick one or more events: the spinner only spins while at least one is active (saves uridium). Tick nothing and it spins always. The badge shows whether the event is live right now.
acc.gg.stop_lives_lost: Stop the account when a gate is lost (out of lives)
acc.gg.stop_lives_lost_note: If the gate's lives run out (you hit 0/N), stop the account entirely instead of continuing to the next gate in the list. Off = keeps the auto-GG going.
acc.gg.stop_noenergy: Stop when no extra energy left
acc.gg.stop_price_note: Cost/spin is the server's LIVE price (already discounted during events: GG day / spins on sale). The assistant refreshes it automatically.
acc.gg.swap_gate_ship: Ship to run the Galaxy gate
acc.gg.swap_ship_hint: The ship list shows on connect; the ★ favourites fill in once the Hangar loads.
acc.gg.swapship_note: Swaps the ACTIVE hangar ship (not the config): a cheap one for spinning, the combat one for the gate. The game only swaps ships while docked.
acc.gg.track_note: When the target you're attacking drifts out of range, the ship adjusts its movement angle to bring it back in close through the most open, safe side, instead of chasing it straight into the pack. If it drifts too far, it drops it and takes the nearest one. Only inside the gate.
acc.gg.trinity.btn_tip: Trinity Trials config (difficulty · OS module · pass)
acc.gg.wave_logic_tip: Per-NPC internal logic (tri-state: inherit / ON / OFF): Kiting, Classic kiting, Bubble, Tracking, Border, Evade-surround, Orbit. Overrides the global 'Internal logic' switches for this NPC only. 'Classic kiting' ON force-OFFs orbit/border/evade for that NPC (and OFF re-enables them even if the global is classic).
acc.gg.wave_note: Rules that switch ship config / drag / rockets / pet / formation based on the NPC present and/or the wave range. The first matching rule wins. NPC-based rules are robust (the wave counter is unreliable after a reconnect). Leave a field empty = no condition / don't change.
acc.gg.wave_range_tip: This NPC's ATTACK range (the ENEMY's): Auto = the automatic value in use (the ship holds OUTSIDE it; live, '—' until set); Fixed = a manual reach applied in THIS gate, overriding the automatic one (empty = use auto). Not to be confused with 'Fire dist.' (your firing position).
acc.gg.wavectl_leavepct_tip: When an NPC drops to this HP %% (where it tends to flee to a corner, ~25%%) AND there's another FRESH NPC to fight, leave it and switch to the fresh one instead of burning the last shots. If NO fresh one remains, finish it anyway (the wave needs kills). Empty = automatic: uses the learned flee threshold (default ~25%%). 100 = disabled.
acc.gg.wavectl_note: With this on, inside a Galaxy Gate the assistant LEAVES the NPCs that flee to the corners (the radiation) and fights the ones following you — killing them to advance the wave, without chasing the runners or diving into the radiation. Keeps it from getting cornered against the edge or stuck chasing one that ran away.
acc.gg.wavectl_toggle: Leave the corner-runners, fight the followers
acc.gg.waveplan_note: Rows pre-loaded with this gate's sections (NPC + waves). Set only what you want to change per section; empty = inherit the general config. Applies to this gate only.
acc.grp.actions_tip: These send packets to the server. They require the assistant to be connected. The server enforces leadership (kick / toggle-open only work if you're the group leader).
acc.grp.adv_userid: UserId of the pilot to follow (0 = don't follow; overridden by "Follow leader automatically" if on)
acc.grp.follow_auto_note: (auto-tracks the current leader; updates if it changes)
acc.grp.follow_cross_note: (tries to jump if the target changed maps)
acc.grp.follow_tip: The ship follows the target — the server moves it toward them (escort / sentinel). You choose the target: the group leader automatically, or a specific member from the panel below.
acc.grp.invite_needs_running: Start this account first — you can only invite a connected account (and that's how we use its exact in-game name).
acc.grp.live_tip: Group state according to the server. Appears when the account is connected and in a group.
acc.grp.merge_tip: Different original server, but merged into the same world as this account → they can still group.
acc.grp.no_siblings_post: . For them to appear here, the other accounts must Load at least once (the server confirms the instance host at login).
acc.grp.no_siblings_pre: You don't have other confirmed accounts on
acc.grp.not_in_group: You're not in a group, or the assistant isn't connected.
acc.grp.siblings: Your other accounts on this server
acc.grp.siblings_tip: Your accounts that can group with this one: on the same server, or on a merge-compatible server (same merged world even if the original server differs). Only accounts that did Load at least once appear. Click 'Invite' to send the invitation to the pilot.
acc.grp.title: Group / follow
acc.hangar.autosell_intro: The assistant keeps X of each listed item and sells the EXCESS for credits (great for CPUs; with the auction = credit income). It EARNS CREDITS and is DESTRUCTIVE. Tip: turn on simulation to see what it would sell without selling.
acc.hangar.autosell_norules: No rules. Pick a bank item below and add it.
acc.hangar.buyslot_warn: Spends real account uridium and can't be undone.
acc.hangar.config_equip_hint: Clicking a spare in the right panel equips it into the visible config (CONFIG 1/2). Boxes with × unequip back to the bank. Changes are server-validated and reversible; the server only answers while the assistant is in a base.
acc.hangar.intro: Your hangar ships. The server only sends the list when the assistant is inside a base — leave the assistant at a base and click Load / refresh.
acc.hangar.intro_buttons_h: The two buttons on each ship:
acc.hangar.intro_change_d: the full swap: disconnects the assistant, activates that ship and reconnects, relocating you to that ship's map. Works from anywhere, ~40s. Same mechanism as the palladium loop and General's active-ship control.
acc.hangar.intro_use_d: activates it in-game right now (no reconnect). Requires being docked at a base, and changes your map to that ship's location. Doesn't work from the 5-2 (pirate) base.
acc.hangar.inventory_intro: All the account's equipment (lasers, generators, shields, CPUs, rockets), equipped or in the bank. Populates on refresh with the assistant at a base.
acc.hangar.lockattr_intro: Items with unstable attributes: their current rolls and the resource cost to lock an attribute or restabilize the item. Read-only — rerolling is done in the game and spends resources.
acc.hangar.noinfo: No info — leave the assistant at a base and click "Load / refresh".
acc.hangar.spares_full_tip: show the full inventory (all categories), not just what this section equips
acc.hangar.swap_intro: When it dies N times in the session, it switches to another hangar ship (free pavilion change: disconnects, activates and reconnects in that ship's map). One-shot per session.
acc.hangar.title: Hangar
acc.hd.disconnect: Disconnects the account from the game
acc.hd.force_confirm:
Force stop the account?

This: kills the worker WITHOUT a natural logout, clears the anti-rate-limit cooldown, and resets the handoff guard. Use it when the account is in a reconnect/captcha loop or the UI state is desynced.
acc.hd.force_stop_tip: Admin only: hard-stop + clear stale state. For cases where normal Stop is not enough.
acc.hd.load_creds_tip: The game rejected the credentials — update username or password from Edit
acc.hd.load_reqs_tip: Missing requirements to load this account (see the notice above)
acc.hd.load_tip: Connects to the game but leaves the assistant paused
acc.hd.loading_tip: Login in progress. Wait for it to finish before operating.
acc.hd.pause_tip: Pauses the assistant but keeps the account connected to the game
acc.hd.premium_refresh_tip: Query the game subscriptions (Premium, Battle Pass) and refresh the expiry date
acc.hd.relogin_confirm:
Reconnect with a fresh login?

It discards the saved session and signs in from scratch. The account disconnects for a moment.
acc.hd.relogin_tip: Restarts the account forcing a full login instead of reusing the saved session. Use it if it's stuck in a reconnect loop and Stop isn't enough.
acc.hd.stop_login_tip: Admin: cancel the in-progress login. Applies when the handshake finishes — for an immediate cut use Force stop.
acc.hud.angle_ruler_note: degrees between rays · u between rings · max u (0 = all)
acc.hud.base_struct: Base structures <small>HQ + Hangar + Repair + OreTrade + Healing + Booster + Buff</small>
acc.hud.bg_note: game texture — HD = better quality, ~140 KB/map
acc.hud.bot_path: Assistant path <small>(line through waypoints — color by FSM state)</small>
acc.hud.bot_target: Assistant target <small>(red line + ring over the attacked NPC, always on top)</small>
acc.hud.bright_note: Brightness of the minimap canvas · Lower opacity = more transparent. Saved per account in this browser.
acc.hud.cbs_lines: Enemy CBS distance line <small>(line + units + laser modules — approach to read the real range)</small>
acc.hud.clan_diplo: Clan diplomacy <small style="font-weight:400;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;color:var(--dim)">— color of [CLAN] in the label based on its relation to your clan</small>
acc.hud.combat_dbg_note: Draws what the engine decided each tick. The disc border shows where the reach in use came from (measured, configured or estimated). The log backs it with the same identifier.
acc.hud.combat_intro: Observed-combat indicators (damage, attack tether, counters) + analysis lines to other map objects.
acc.hud.damage_numbers: Floating damage numbers <small>(+123 / -45 over the victim, 1.5s)</small>
acc.hud.death_overlay: Death / respawn overlay <small>(banner + countdown, works while paused)</small>
acc.hud.diag_intro: Measurement and diagnostic tools (admin / developer mode only).
acc.hud.drop_labels_show: Show the item name on the map
acc.hud.drops_intro: Collectables. Each sub-type has its own toggle. The group color (boxes / GOLD / mineral / mine) is next to the master.
acc.hud.frame_note: OFF = no background, no border, no blue side bar (panels "float" over the minimap)
acc.hud.gate_hidden: Show hidden gates <small>(server marked as invisible)</small>
acc.hud.gate_portal: Sector portal <small>(hollow blue ring — connects to another map)</small>
acc.hud.gen_intro: Presets replace all toggles at once; then you can fine-tune in the other sections.
acc.hud.gg_damage: Damage taken per wave <small>(red bar in the gate)</small>
acc.hud.labels_all: Show all labels <small>master · OFF = no text on the minimap</small>
acc.hud.labels_intro: Which text to show over minimap markers: names, clan tags and per-type labels. One place to turn all text off.
acc.hud.lbl_clan: Clan tag <small>[CLAN] next to the name</small>
acc.hud.leg_admin: gold ring + dashed red ring (ship_admin / ship_g-admincloak / *_referee)
acc.hud.leg_ghost: last seen position of a ship (fog-of-war)
acc.hud.leg_hero: green chevron with a pulsing ring
acc.hud.leg_rangemark: marked range around a ship (follows the ship)
acc.hud.legend_intro: What each tint and shape means on the minimap.
acc.hud.markers_intro: Ships and live objects on the map: players, NPCs, PETs and their indicators. Masters toggle the whole category; sub-filters pick subtypes.
acc.hud.mine_lines: Line + distance to mines <small>(ship → mine, u)</small>
acc.hud.mine_range: Mine activation zone <small>(circle of the radius the assistant avoids, u)</small>
acc.hud.neutral_note: About "neutral": it's a technical fallback for players/pets where the server does NOT send a faction (pirates on pirate maps, events with special cloak, etc.). Rare but it happens. If you want to change the colors above — they're ready to use.
acc.hud.npc_low: Tier 1-3 <small>(Streuner, Lordakia, Saimon, Mordon, Sibelon, Devolarium)</small>
acc.hud.panel_alerts_note: Mirrors the game's own on-screen text alerts/notifications (separate channel from the LOG).
acc.hud.panel_boosters_note: active boosters: type, benefit % and time left
acc.hud.panel_labs_note: Lab upgrades: mineral, benefit % (reference) and amount/time left
acc.hud.panel_log_note: mirrors the game's log feed: outcomes, rewards and notices
acc.hud.panel_pet_note: HP / Shield / Fuel / Level — only if you have an active pet
acc.hud.panel_stats_note: real-time diagnostics (shifts if TARGET is also in TR)
acc.hud.panel_target_note: only visible when there's a target
acc.hud.panels_intro: Each HUD panel is a card. Master = show/hide the whole panel. Position = corner of the canvas (TL/TR/BL/BR). Layer = "Over" (default) or "Under" the minimap (markers show on top). Transparency = 0-100 % of the background. Brightness = 50-150 % of the text and border.
acc.hud.preset_soft_note: Presets only change what's shown — they don't touch your colors or panel positions. 'Restore defaults' resets everything.
acc.hud.range_marks: Range circles <small>(MarkRange — anchored to a ship)</small>
acc.hud.routes_intro: The assistant's routes and movement marks on the minimap: planned path, intent and current objective.
acc.hud.saved_per_account: saved per account (this browser) · applies instantly
acc.hud.show_aoi: Vision perimeter <small>(measured AOI — what the ship sees)</small>
acc.hud.show_cbs_range: Enemy CBS range ring <small>(no-go hitbox the assistant avoids)</small>
acc.hud.show_painted: Show painted zones <small>(master: preferred green + avoided red)</small>
acc.hud.show_pets: Show pets <small>(master for all visible pets)</small>
acc.hud.struct_intro: Fixed map objects. Each type has its own toggle (show/hide) and a color picker next to it. The "Base structures" master still groups HQ/Hangar/Repair/OreTrade/HealingPod/Booster/Buff — if it's OFF, all of those are hidden regardless of their sub-toggles.

acc.npc.ability_crowd_tip: Activate this ability/item when many enemies are clustered near you (smartbomb, EMP…). Great for gate waves. Enter the slot-bar menuItemId. Empty = off.
acc.npc.ability_lowhp_tip: Activate this slot-bar ability/item when YOUR HP drops to/below the threshold (instant shield, heal…). Enter the slot-bar menuItemId. Empty = off.
acc.npc.ability_only_tagged: Offensive ability only on tagged NPCs
acc.npc.ability_only_tagged_tip: When on, the offensive ability above only fires against NPCs with the 'Ability' box ticked in the NPC table (e.g. EMP only vs Devolariums). Off = against any NPC matching the HP/range conditions.
acc.npc.ammo_ability_intro: The NPC table can override ammo per-NPC with AttackKey.
acc.npc.approach_if_tip: If the target is farther than this threshold, the assistant approaches before opening fire. Default: 700 u.
acc.npc.auto_launcher_tip: While attacking an NPC, fires a full salvo with the rocket launcher and waits for the full reload before the next. Activates the launcher weapon (auto-detected); the loaded rocket follows the 'Launcher ammo'. Without it, the ammo is only selected, not fired.
acc.npc.auto_orbit_tip: Automatically orbits at your laser's max reach (learned live from the server), adapting to each ship/config — no fixed number. Overrides the 'Default orbit radius'. An explicit per-NPC radius in the table still wins.
acc.npc.auto_rocket_tip: While attacking an NPC, fires the 'Default rocket' (or the per-NPC rocket) automatically at the rocket's real reload rate. Without it, the rocket is only selected, not fired.
acc.npc.default_ammo_tip: Global ammo the assistant uses when attacking NPCs. The NPC table can override it per-NPC with AttackKey (e.g. UCB-100 on bosses, LCB-10 on streuners). Autocomplete from the catalog or a custom menuItemId.
acc.npc.default_rocket_tip: Rocket active when engaging an NPC. Per-NPC override in the table → AttackRocket. Empty = no rocket change.
acc.npc.drop_target_tip: If the target moves farther than this radius, the assistant discards it and looks for another. Default: 3000 u.
acc.npc.fallback_ammo_tip: Laser ammo the assistant fires WHILE the RSB is on cooldown (so the laser never stops). Empty = falls back to SAB / per-NPC AttackKey / default ammo.
acc.npc.group_npcs: Group NPCs with the same name
acc.npc.group_npcs_tip: When picking a target, prioritizes NPCs whose same-name cluster is nearby (kill groups in a chain instead of lone NPCs). Michelin: ON.
acc.npc.if_npc_maxhp_tip: Only spends the ability if the NPC has at least this max HP (otherwise it is wasted on streuners). 0 = any NPC.
acc.npc.if_your_shield_tip: Activate SAB when your shield drops to this %. Default: 80%.
acc.npc.intro: When and how to attack NPCs. The assistant orbits the target keeping distance (the Radius from its rule in the NPC table, or the default here if the rule lacks one), circles if it moves, and finishes in flee config below 25% HP.
acc.npc.launcher_ammo_tip: Which rocket the rocket launcher loads (ammunition_rocketlauncher_*). The assistant SELECTS it when engaging an NPC. Per-NPC override in the table → AttackRocketLauncher. Empty = no launcher ammo change. (The weapon itself is auto-detected — see Auto Launcher.)
acc.npc.launcher_cap_tip: How many missiles the launcher loads (salvo size). Full reload = 3 s base + capacity × 1 s; the assistant waits for that full reload so the whole salvo fires (firing earlier sends an incomplete one). It is AUTO-DETECTED from the equipped launcher (HST-2/Hydra/Neptune = 5, HST-1/Triskelion = 3). This value is only used if the launcher is not in the catalog.
acc.npc.npc_shield_ge_tip: Only activate SAB if the NPC has at least this shield (otherwise it wastes ammo). Default: 12000.
acc.npc.off_ability_tip: Fired once per NPC, ~4 s after locking the target, if the NPC is tough enough (max HP ≥ threshold) and you are close.
acc.npc.orbit_radius_tip: Orbit radius in u — used when the NPC table rule does not specify its own. Default: 500 u.
acc.npc.prio_closest_tip: Outside a gate, always target the NEAREST killable NPC (distance beats the table priority and HP) — stops the bot chasing a fleeing or far NPC while easy ones are in close range (e.g. 5-2). Opt-in, default OFF.
acc.npc.rsb_cd_tip: RSB reload in ms. The ship fires an RSB pulse and uses the 'fallback ammo' during the reload, then returns.
acc.npc.rsb_item_tip: RSB laser ammo. Autocomplete from the catalog or paste a custom item id.
acc.npc.run_cfg_in_circle_tip: Switches to the 'Fleeing' config during the finishing orbit (NPC HP < 25%). Useful for drag-and-dropping a speed module to finish fast. Michelin: ON.
acc.npc.sab_item_tip: SAB slot-bar item. Autocomplete from the catalog or paste a custom menuItemId.
acc.npc.sab_rsb_intro: Activate Shield Absorber Battery / Rocket Shield Booster against tough NPCs.
acc.npc.search_range_tip: Maximum distance at which the assistant considers an NPC a target. Michelin default: 1200 u.
acc.npc.smart_circle_tip: How much effort the ship puts into picking a good orbit point while dodging barriers/CBS. Higher = better dodging but a bit more CPU.
acc.npc.stop_recover_tip: Hysteresis: once SAB activates on dropping below the % above, it keeps firing until the shield recovers to this %. 0 (default) = no hysteresis: stops firing the instant the shield rises past the trigger. Recommended: 95% — avoids SAB on/off flicker when the shield wobbles.
acc.npc.title: NPC killer
acc.npc.use_rsb_tip: Premium laser ammo. Fired in pulses: one shot, then during its reload it uses the 'fallback ammo', then returns — in a cycle. It's ammo, not a rocket. Priority RSB > SAB. Triggered by the NPC's RB tag (no shield condition).
acc.npc.use_sab_tip: Activates Shield Absorber Battery: drains the NPC shield and transfers it to yours. Useful for bosses / tough NPCs.
acc.npt.catalog_help: Mark which NPCs you attack (✓ Kill) and tweak priority / radius / flags. Click the row to open the advanced panel (AttackKey, Formation, Maps).
acc.npt.col_hl_tip: Switch the pet to HP Link against this NPC (requires the per-NPC option in the Pet block).
acc.npt.col_p_tip: Passive — only attack it if it attacks you first
acc.npt.col_radius_tip: Combat / orbit radius in units (empty = default)
acc.npt.col_rb_tip: Use RSB against this NPC (requires the global RSB option enabled).
acc.npt.col_sa_tip: Use SAB against this NPC (requires SabEnabled + SabOnlyTaggedNpcs in global config)
acc.npt.col_second_tip: Second — only if another ship is already attacking it
acc.npt.counter_tip: NPCs with the ✓ Kill box ticked · click to show only those
acc.npt.f_ability_tip: Use the offensive ability against this NPC. Works together with the 'Offensive ability only on tagged NPCs' toggle: with that on, the ability only fires against NPCs tagged here.
acc.npt.f_drag_tip: Instead of orbiting the NPC, the assistant positions on the map-center → NPC line and moves away, dragging the NPC along with the laser aggro. Useful to pull slow NPCs (Cubikon-like) out of their spawn zone.
acc.npt.f_harass_tip: Chase it ~25% closer once it drops below 25% HP.
acc.npt.f_ignorebox_tip: Focus only on this NPC: don't divert to boxes (steer or adjacent grab) while fighting it.
acc.npt.f_leech_tip: Attack ONLY if a GROUP member is already attacking it — focus the group's fire. With no group, or no groupmate on it, the assistant won't engage.
acc.npt.intro: Per-NPC rules. The assistant attacks the NPC with the lowest priority (tie ⇒ the most damaged ⇒ the nearest). Names are fuzzy-matched — Streuner matches Streuner-X, and Boss Streuner is a separate entry.
acc.npt.k_ability_tip: Ship ability to use ONLY against this NPC (slot-bar menuItemId) — a different one than the global offensive ability (e.g. EMP vs Devolarium, another vs a boss). If set, it always fires here (bypasses the 'only tagged NPCs' toggle). Empty = use the global ability.
acc.npt.k_ammo_tip: Laser ammo for this NPC. Empty = the default ammo from the NPC killer block. Type/pick one to force another. Tick 'don't use' to NOT fire the laser (kill only with rocket/launcher, e.g. rocket rewards — it still locks it).
acc.npt.k_cfg_tip: Switch the ship config (1..4) when engaging this NPC. 0 = use the global OffensiveConfig (default). Useful for bosses that need a different loadout than regular operating.
acc.npt.k_formation_tip: Forced formation for this NPC. Pick from the catalog (autocomplete) or paste a custom menuItemId. Empty = follows the NPC killer block formation.
acc.npt.k_launcher_tip: Rocket launcher for this NPC. Empty = follows the default launcher. Tick 'don't use' to not fire the launcher at this NPC, even if Auto Launcher is ON.
acc.npt.k_maps_tip: Comma-separated map IDs where the rule applies (e.g. 1,2,5). Empty = all maps.
acc.npt.k_rocket_tip: Rocket for this NPC. Empty = follows the default rocket. Tick 'don't use' to not fire a rocket at this NPC (save on small mobs), even if Auto Rocket is ON.
acc.npt.learned_tip: Average range the assistant has been learning for this NPC (informational only — doesn't affect combat yet).
acc.npt.outside_grid_tip: Default OFF: the ship ignores NPCs whose coords fall outside the map's playable rectangle. ON: it chases them anyway. Risk: it can get stuck chasing NPCs in radiation zones.
acc.npt.r_def_post: u) — persisted when you save the config. You can change it freely.
acc.npt.r_none: No cataloged default — empty uses the global 'Default orbit radius'.
acc.npt.reset_body:
Clears ✓ Kill, priority, radius and flags on EVERY row, and removes custom rows.

Since whitelist mode is on, the assistant stops attacking until you mark NPCs with Kill ✓.

acc.pal.auto_toggle_tip: Turns palladium collection on as a capability (like auto-GG): farms in 5-3, passive combat, sell loop in 5-2 and death-recovery. It uses its own maps (5-3 farm / 5-2 sell); the Working map selector stays free for normal mode.
acc.pal.autosetup: Auto-place the ships on start (first time)
acc.pal.autosetup_note: First time: if the ships aren't in their maps, the assistant places them — travels to 5-2 with the collection ship, warps the sell ship in at the OreTrade (leaving it in 5-2) and warps back, then goes to 5-3. You only pick the two ships; the maps (5-3 farm / 5-2 sell) are known automatically.
acc.pal.bay_farm_hint: The one you mine palladium with, inside the 5-3 field.
acc.pal.bay_sell_hint: Disposable: it just travels to 5-2, exchanges the palladium and returns. Never repaired.
acc.pal.death_enable: Return to collecting after dying (via sell ship + activate)
acc.pal.death_note: If you die collecting, the collection ship ends up in base. The assistant: repairs to 100% in base → swaps to the sell ship (relocates you to its map, e.g. 5-2) → in-game WARP to the collection ship (no reconnect — works in 5-2, where the activate doesn't) → travels to the collection zone. Uses the same ships as the loop above. ⚠ The collection ship must be marked FAVOURITE (only favourites are warpable) and the warp costs voucher/uridium.
acc.pal.death_wait_every_tip: Every N accumulated deaths in the run (N, 2N, 3N…) it waits the time below before returning to collect. 0 = never wait (always return straight away).
acc.pal.favourite_note: Important: the collection and sell ships must be marked as FAVOURITE — the warp return only works with favourite ships. The assistant marks them on start if they aren't; still, it's best to keep them favourited manually.
acc.pal.hero_tagline: Mine in 5-3, exchange in 5-2, repeat. You pick two ships; the rest is automatic.
acc.pal.mining_auto_note: 5-3's palladium field is a damage-over-time (DOT) zone: when you pick the Palladium module the assistant enters and mines there AUTOMATICALLY — nothing to enable. Critical-HP flee/repair stays the safety net; minefield, cage and no-access zones are still avoided.
acc.pal.sell_no_repair: Don't repair the sell ship (5-2 / hangar)
acc.pal.sell_no_repair_note: While on the sell ship (in 5-2 / during the hangar-swap) the assistant won't flee to heal: it exchanges the palladium and swaps back to collect. On 5-3 (collection ship) it repairs normally. The sell ship is throwaway, so healing it just breaks the cycle. Doesn't affect fleeing from real threats (players / CBS).
acc.pal.sell_pct_note: 0 or 100 = only when cargo is full. 1-99 = go sell once cargo reaches that % (handy for testing the loop without waiting to fill up). Palladium still needs 15 or more to exchange.
acc.pal.sell_throwaway_note: Mark the sell ship as throwaway: it's only for sitting in 5-2 and exchanging, unequipped. Implies «don't repair». In palladium mode the ship only moves via the cycle's warp.
acc.pal.setup_note: 1) Load the hangar at a base to populate the ships. 2) Pick the COLLECTION ship (5-3) and the SELL ship (5-2). That's it — selling palladium, damage-zone mining and the 5-2 exchange all turn on automatically when you enable Palladium. The 5-3 and 5-2 maps are handled by the module itself.

acc.pet.activate_tip: Launches the pet now and leaves the master switch ON (the assistant keeps it active).
acc.pet.autofuel_tip: When the pet's fuel drops below the threshold, it buys a refill automatically. Buying before running dry avoids downtime. 0 = only buys when the server declares it out of fuel.
acc.pet.autorepair: Repair the pet automatically if it dies
acc.pet.autorepair_tip: Repairs the pet as soon as it's detected dead. Costs in-game credits each time. Use the limits below to avoid burning credits in a loop if the pet keeps dying.
acc.pet.combo_tip: Switches to the gear that heals your ship at the pet's expense when your HP falls below this %. Unlike the pet repairer, this one heals you. 0 = off.
acc.pet.deactivate_tip: Recalls the pet now and leaves the master switch OFF (the assistant won't relaunch it).
acc.pet.equip_empty: No info — the server sends the hangar dump only when the assistant enters a base. Once it lands, this list will fill in on its own.
acc.pet.equip_tip: Configs equipped on the pet (up to 4). The server only sends them when the account is inside a base/station, so it shows empty in space.
acc.pet.follow_loc: Follow the pet locator while roaming
acc.pet.follow_loc_tip: When the pet has a Locator mode active, the server emits pings with the position of the NPC/mineral it detects. With this on, the assistant prioritizes those coordinates while roaming. Pings older than 30 s fall back to the normal behaviour.
acc.pet.g_beaconcombat_tip: The pet emits a ring granting extra damage to nearby allies for a while. On cooldown.
acc.pet.g_beaconhp_tip: The pet emits a ring granting extra HP to nearby allies for a while. On cooldown.
acc.pet.g_box_tip: The pet collects nearby boxes automatically. Always active.
acc.pet.g_combo_tip: The pet repairs your ship with a strong, short burst. On a server-side cooldown.
acc.pet.g_guard_tip: The pet shoots nearby NPCs while you're in combat. No cooldown.
acc.pet.g_heat_tip: The pet releases built-up heat around it. On cooldown. Useful against SAB/ability overheating.
acc.pet.g_hplink_tip: Healing chain from the pet to your ship for a few seconds. On cooldown. Triggered by the smart-switch if you configure its triggers.
acc.pet.g_kamikaze_tip: The pet self-destructs and explodes in an area. Once used, it dies (needs repair).
acc.pet.g_locnpc_tip: The pet detects nearby NPCs and pings their position. Combine with 'Follow the pet locator while roaming' below.
acc.pet.g_locore_tip: The pet detects nearby minerals and pings their position. Useful for collecting palladium/seprom.
acc.pet.g_megamine_tip: The pet lays a large explosive mine. On cooldown.
acc.pet.g_ore_tip: The pet collects nearby minerals automatically. Always active.
acc.pet.g_passive_tip: The pet does nothing actively. Saves fuel.
acc.pet.g_petrepair_tip: The pet heals your ship fast for a few seconds. No cooldown (rechargeable).
acc.pet.g_retarget_tip: The pet switches its target with priority for a while. On cooldown. Useful to force what it chases.
acc.pet.g_sacrifice_tip: The pet sacrifices itself for a nearby ally. On cooldown. Kills the pet.
acc.pet.g_trade_tip: The pet acts as a cargo trader. On a cooldown between uses.
acc.pet.hpl_only_shoot: Only if I'm shooting an NPC
acc.pet.hpl_only_tagged: Only against NPCs tagged with HP Link in the table
acc.pet.hpl_only_tagged_tip: Tick the NPC rule in the NPC Killer table with the HP Link field to enable it per-NPC. Same pattern as SAB/RSB tagged.
acc.pet.hplink_ss_tip: Switches the pet's gear to HP Link (a chain that heals your ship from the pet's health) when one of the triggers below is met. The 'gates' filter: e.g. 'only if I'm firing at an NPC' avoids firing it when the pet enters combat alone.
acc.pet.loc_ignore: Locator: ignore X seconds if there's no valid target
acc.pet.loc_ignore_tip: If the locator pings (X,Y) but there's no box, mineral or killable NPC within ~2000u of the ping, the assistant ignores the locator for this number of seconds. Avoids chasing phantom pings. 0 = always trust it.
acc.pet.loc_target_tip: The pet locator can ping any target in range or lock onto a specific one. 0 = no preference, let the server decide. Valid IDs are sent by the server when the gear activates (in the Live tab).
acc.pet.modes_avail_only_tip: Shows only the modes the pet has equipped (★), hiding the rest. The available modes arrive from the server once the pet is activated; before that, all are shown.
acc.pet.pal_collect_tip: In Palladium mode the pet auto-mines ore: it activates the pet, buys fuel, and repairs it if destroyed. If you're attacked or low on HP it switches to defend/heal and then goes back to mining on its own. One toggle — no need to touch the pet mode or fuel.
acc.pet.repair_limit_tip: Failsafe on top of 'Repair the pet if it dies'. The delay is the minimum between consecutive attempts (0 = default 10 s). The window limit cuts the loop if the pet keeps dying: at most N repairs per M minutes.
acc.pet.repair_now_tip: Repairs the pet now. Costs in-game credits. Only has effect if the pet is destroyed.
acc.pet.smart_tip: With ON, the pet picks the most useful mode by context, in this priority order: 1) REPAIR (heals your ship) if your HP drops below the flee threshold or you're repairing; 2) combo-repair / HP-link if you configured them and their condition fires; 3) GUARD (defense) if 2+ NPCs are attacking you at once; 4) otherwise your chosen base mode (or ore-collecting if the pet Palladium mode is on). It returns to the base mode on its own once the danger passes. Off = always keeps your chosen mode, no overrides.
acc.pet.status_none: No data — activate the pet to see its status.
acc.pet.t_beaconcombat_tip: Area +damage ring each time you start attacking an NPC. On cooldown.
acc.pet.t_beaconhp_tip: Area +HP ring when enough active allies are in the group. On cooldown. Requires being in a group. 0 = off.
acc.pet.t_heat: Heat Release (20) when the pet's heat exceeds
acc.pet.t_heat_tip: When the pet heats up past the threshold, it releases heat to cool down. On cooldown. 0 = off.
acc.pet.t_kamikaze_tip: One-shot kill on the current NPC when it's low on health. Kills the pet (needs repair). 0 = off.
acc.pet.t_megamine_tip: Lays the mine when there are multiple attackers. On cooldown. 0 = off.
acc.pet.t_retarget_tip: Switches the pet's target when you change NPC. On cooldown.
acc.pet.t_sacrifice: Sacrificial flame (14) when an ally's HP <
acc.pet.t_sacrifice_tip: Saves the group member at critical HP. KILLS the pet (needs repair). On cooldown. Requires being in a group. 0 = off.

acc.pet.triggers_tip: Activates specific gears only when a condition is met (instead of keeping them as a permanent default every 45 s). Requires Automatic smart-switch ON. Server-side cooldowns respected.

acc.sky.auto_prio: AUTO-UPGRADE · ore priority (0 = don't use · 1 = first)

acc.sky.refine_intro: Refine (with the number next to it) = produces that amount once, now. Auto = the assistant automatically refines all available material of that ore every ~30 s (the number does not affect Auto), checking first that you have the raw materials.
acc.sky.sell_before: Sell the whole cargo before each auto-transport
acc.sky.sell_before_note: Before each auto-transport, the assistant goes to sell the whole cargo at the refinery (the Sell map you configured, or your faction's nearest base) to make room for the Skylab's minerals. The assistant must be running (Start). Palladium below 15 can't be exchanged, so it's left accumulating and ignored. (Only applies to the auto-transport — not the button, not the palladium 5-2 mode.)

landing.faq.a1: The service we offer is 100% legal — it is personal automation software. It may contravene the videogame's terms of use, which you assume at your own risk. We are not affiliated with the game operator or its subsidiaries.
landing.faq.a2: We cannot guarantee you won't be banned — that decision belongs to the game operator. What we do: the assistant simulates human behaviour (irregular timings, escapes, breaks, no perfect afk) and detects admin presence to shut down automatically. We reduce the risk, we don't eliminate it.
landing.faq.a3: When the game operator ships major updates, the assistant pauses automatically. During that pause your license days are not consumed, and when the service comes back we compensate you with extra time equivalent to the pause. It is transparent — you see the notice in the panel.
landing.faq.a4: Yes, within 14 days of purchase and if the key remains intact (never assigned to an account). Once you assign a key the service begins on it and the refund right is waived (EU art. 103.m).
landing.faq.a5: NEVER. Each purchase is a single payment, decided by you. We don't save your card for future charges. There is no 'free trial that charges you later'.
landing.faq.a6: From your profile at any time. You delete your account yourself, no need to email support. Your personal data is removed within 30 days.
landing.faq.a7: Hosting on Hetzner servers (a German company) in the EU and the US. Passwords hashed with bcrypt. Game credentials encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. GDPR compliant: you can export or delete all your data anytime from your profile.
